data.one_liner: Render network images on the web using CanvasKit without CORS issues.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to render images on the web using CanvasKit without encountering CORS problems. It also supports Android and iOS platforms with customizable loading, error handling, and border radius options.
use_when: You are building a Flutter web app using CanvasKit and facing CORS issues with network images.
You need a cross-platform image widget with built-in loading and error placeholders.
avoid_when: You need advanced offline caching features out of the box without relying on additional packages like CachedNetworkImage.
strengths: Solves CORS problems for web images when using CanvasKit.
Provides built-in customization for loading widgets, error widgets, border radius, and tap actions.
weaknesses: Android and iOS support accept https images only.
Caching on Android and iOS is recommended to be handled with CachedNetworkImage.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need robust and advanced image caching and management out of the box.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need core image manipulation and decoding utilities.

data.minimal_example:
ImageNetwork(
    image: "https://storage.googleapis.com/cms-storage-bucket/a9d6ce81aee44ae017ee.png",
    height: 350.0,
    width: 240.0,
    duration: 1500,
    curve: Curves.easeIn,
    onPointer: true,
    debugPrint: false,
    backgroundColor: Colors.blue,
    fitAndroidIos: BoxFit.cover,
    fitWeb: BoxFitWeb.cover,
    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(70),
)
